scope: Source audit of global-lemma dependency ordering in fixed local WP source; no complete tool soundness theorem
findings: LogicUsage.lemma_of_global stores only the prior proofcontext as lem_depends (lines186-194).

The visitor creates/registers a top-level lemma before adding it to proofcontext (lines390-394). Therefore later top-level lemmas and the current lemma itself are not automatically proof hypotheses for that lemma.
cfgWP.compile_lemma supplies that lem_depends list as the VC axioms (line1638).

All candidate top-level lemma obligations still must actually pass; main WP can use their declarations, so a missing/failed lemma prevents admission. No new axiomatic blocks are allowed by the frozen checker.
